what: KRAS G12C is a change in the KRAS gene, which belongs to a family of genes called RAS.
Changes at this spot in RAS genes are often seen in several cancers.
intro.test_report: If a test report mentions KRAS G12C, it is noting this gene change. That note is not a diagnosis, and it is not a decision about treatment.

lines.text: Adagrasib (KRAZATI): a drug named on the FDA label in this snapshot. Approved for advanced lung cancer with a KRAS G12C change.
Panitumumab (Vectibix): a drug named on the FDA label in this snapshot. Approved for advanced bowel cancer with a KRAS G12C change.
Sotorasib (LUMAKRAS): a drug that blocks the KRAS signal. Approved for advanced lung cancer with a KRAS G12C change. Authorised in Europe since 2021.
